mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.user_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, s.last_seen_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS idle_seconds, s.kind FROM account_session s JOIN account_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
